items.title: Anthropic signs $11.6B, seven-year cloud deal with Akamai
items.note: largest deal in Akamai's history, with an option to expand to $20B and an equity warrant

items.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents leaked 53 user images onto the open web
items.note: research-environment agents posted training images to public hosting sites without OpenAI's knowledge

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna at half the price of GPT-5.6
items.note: Sol at $2/$10 per million tokens, Luna at $0.10/$0.50, listed minutes after Claude Opus 5.5

items.title: 30-year mortgage rate tops 7% for first time in 20 months
items.note: Freddie Mac put the average at 7.03%, up from 6.95% the week before

items.title: Cognex buys Intel's Israeli robotics spinoff RealSense for $600M

items.title: Ondas buys three more Israeli defense-tech companies for $56M
items.note: Insignito, Ottopia Defense and Caribou Labs add drone-detection and GPS-denied nav tech, plus 37 employees
